//num_streams: Number of GPU streams. Memory per stream is auto-scaled from VRAM.
//min_n: queries with less anchors will be handled on cpu
//long_seg_buffer_size: single-stream baseline (auto-scaled by num_streams and VRAM).
//max_total_n, max_read: single-stream baseline values. Auto-scaled by num_streams and actual GPU VRAM.

range_kernel.//cut_check_anchors: Number of anchors to check to attemp a cut
range_kernel.//anchor_per_block: Number of anchors each block handle. Must be int * blockdim

score_kernel.//micro_batch: Number of micro batches to aggregate into one long kernel. Make sure your host memory size is at least micro_batch * device mem size * 2
score_kernel.//long_griddim: To achieve the best occupancy for the long kernel, long_griddim is usually optimal at 2* No. of CUs
